claims.explanation: Selective killing by JNJ-26481585 is associated with activation of RTK/RAS/PI3K pathways (EGFR, BRAF, NRAS, NF1, PTEN, STK11) and defects in DNA repair (ATM) or chromatin remodeling (ARID1A, KMT2D), while KRAS mutation and TP53 mutation are associated with resistance. This pattern suggests that HDAC inhibition preferentially kills cells with oncogenic signaling and impaired DNA damage response, potentially via ROS-mediated apoptosis and p53 acetylation.

p53 up-acetylation mediates HDACi apoptosis; TP53 mutation more frequent in resistant lines (16/18 vs 13/18).
